0022600024.text: The Suns (1-1, 8th in the West and 2nd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back) host the Nuggets (1-1, 7th in the West and 4th in the Northwest, 1.5 games back) in Emirates NBA Cup West Group A play, with both teams coming off a win. Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery) and Oso Ighodaro (oblique strain) are out for Phoenix, and Julian Strawther (knee sprain) is out for Denver. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Suns lost all three meetings in 2025-26, including a 125-123 loss in Phoenix on March 24, 2026.
